summary: The tower at 1455 Third Street (eleven stories per ArchDaily and the Assessor roll; its new-construction permit says 'erect 12 stories'), part of the Uber headquarters campus designed by SHoP Architects (per ArchDaily) and developed by a joint venture of Alexandria Real Estate Equities (51 percent) and Uber (49 percent) formed in September 2014; the Department of Building Inspection shows its new-construction permit completed on 2021-04-01, and Uber confirmed in October 2023 that OpenAI is leasing 1455 and 1515 Third Street from it.

milestones.text: Alexandria Real Estate Equities and Uber form a joint venture and acquire the 1455/1515 Third Street land parcels for ground-up development of two Class A buildings (422,980 rentable sq ft together); 15-year lease to Uber for 100 percent of the project
Department of Building Inspection new-construction permit application 201508245071 filed to erect 12 stories for office and daycare at 1455 3rd St (estimated cost $66,591,018)
SocketSite reports pile drivers arriving and permit paperwork filed to start driving piles for the headquarters building
Permit 201606039050 for installation of foundation piles (114 piles) issued

Permit completion event: the Department of Building Inspection records new-construction permit 201508245071 (filed under Assessor lot 033) as complete, with a completed date of 2021-04-01 (a permit closeout date, not an occupancy date); the Assessor roll for lot 033 gives 2021 as year built. ArchDaily gives 2022 as the completion year (see the 2022 entry and the open questions)
An Uber spokesperson confirms OpenAI is leasing two buildings from Uber's Mission Bay headquarters, 1455 and 1515 Third St (a lease report, not a move-in date)

details.text: Land cost: Alexandria Real Estate Equities' third quarter 2014 supplemental information gives the $125.0 million purchase price as including 423 parking structure spaces, foundation piles, plans and permits, 49 percent funded by Uber.

Tenant: OpenAI was reported in October 2023 to be leasing both 1455 and 1515 Third St from Uber; The Real Deal (2023-10-29) describes them as two of the four buildings of Uber's Mission Bay headquarters and says Uber 'will continue to occupy the remaining buildings on its campus'.

open_questions: Parcel 8721035 first appears on the Assessor roll for 2023 with the same location as lot 8721033 (rolls to 2022) and a lot area of 38,459 sq ft; the permits are filed under lot 033. No source read explains the lot merger, so the permit and 2021 year-built evidence is attached to this record through the shared 1455 3rd St address.

The map note's 486,600 sq ft combined OpenAI sublease figure and 'largest SF office lease since 2018' (The Real Deal) could not be read (access refused); the San Francisco Standard says only 'nearly a half-million square feet' and 'largest office lease in San Francisco since 2018'.

No source read gives a groundbreaking date or an opening or move-in month; the Department of Building Inspection completed date is a permit closeout date. SocketSite (2016) expected occupancy by mid-2018; the permit shows 2021.
Sources disagree on stories (11 on the Assessor roll, 12 proposed on the permit, eleven in ArchDaily).

Stories: ArchDaily describes "an eleven-story tower at 1455 Third Street" and the Assessor roll (parcel 8721033, roll year 2022) gives 11.0 stories, while DBI new-construction permit 201508245071 reads "erect 12 stories for office, daycare" with 12 proposed stories (DataSF i98e-djp9). The permit may count a level the other two do not; no source explains the difference.

Completion year: sources give different dates of different kinds. The Department of Building Inspection shows new-construction permit 201508245071 complete on 2021-04-01 (permit completion event; DataSF i98e-djp9, filed under lot 033); the Assessor roll for lot 033 (2022 roll) gives year built 2021 (Assessor year built; parcel 8721035's own 2023 to 2025 rolls give none); ArchDaily's project page says 'Completed in 2022' (completion year for the two-building project). The page shows the 2021-04 and 2022 entries side by side, each labeled by kind; no source read reconciles them.

Whether OpenAI occupies 1455 3rd St, and since when, is not settled by any source read. Its status here is 'announced', the 2023 expected state from lease reports (the San Francisco Standard, 2023-10-27, says OpenAI 'will be taking over' the space). Later reports speak of OpenAI's footprint without naming a building as occupied: the San Francisco Standard (2026-02-26) says OpenAI 'now occupies more than 1 million square feet in San Francisco’s Mission Bay neighborhood'; Hoodline (2026-01-09) says the company 'controls about 486,600 square feet through a sublease it picked up from Uber at 1455 and 1515 Third Street'; The Real Deal (2026-03-16) says OpenAI 'in recent years has subleased two buildings from Uber at 1455 and 1515 Third Street'. DataSF Registered Business Locations lists OpenAI registrations at 1455 3rd St starting 2022-12-28 and 2024-03-05; those are registration dates, not opening dates.
